mapper.update: MERGE INTO MST_REFRESH_TOKEN T USING (SELECT #{dto.userId} AS USER_ID FROM DUAL) S ON (T.USER_ID = S.USER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET REFRESH_TOKEN = #{dto.refreshToken}, EXPIRE_DATE = #{dto.expireDate}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{dto.userId} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( USER_ID, REFRESH_TOKEN, EXPIRE_DATE, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{dto.userId}, #{dto.refreshToken}, #{dto.expireDate}, SYSDATE, #{dto.userId} )
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, REFRESH_TOKEN, EXPIRE_DATE FROM MST_REFRESH_TOKEN WHERE USER_ID = #{loginUserId}
